title: Tilt Reaction
description: Thẻ nghiêng 16° về phía bị bấm rồi bật về, hơi quá một chút, bóng đổ rộng ra theo góc nghiêng.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tilt-reaction, written here): Rotation about the centre after a press on one side (sign follows the side): 0 → 16° in 120 ms power2.out, → −3° by 300 ms, → 0 by 480 ms (power2.inOut segments); contact shadow widens with |angle| (+0.6 % per degree). Recipe variant: 0 → 18° (308 ms) → 0 (560 ms) back.out. Demo: the cursor taps the right side, then the left 1.1 s later. Params: angle: góc (16°) · side: bên bấm (trái | phải) · duration (0.48 s).
